name: PrivacyScrubber ZTDS Guard
author: Ilya Sibiryakov

sections.description:
PrivacyScrubber ZTDS Guard (Plane 6 of the PrivacyScrubber ecosystem) enforces the Zero-Trust Data Sanitization (ZTDS™ RFC v1.0) protocol on WordPress contact, patient intake, legal consultation, and financial onboarding forms.

When a visitor submits a form on your WordPress site, sensitive data frequently flows into third-party webhooks (Zapier, Make), CRM systems (HubSpot, Salesforce), Slack notifications, and AI triage bots (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude). PrivacyScrubber ZTDS Guard intercepts the form submission inside the visitor’s browser RAM (<0.4ms) during the DOM capture phase—before fetch() or XMLHttpRequest sends data over the network.

Dual-Envelope Architecture

  1. Public Envelope (Sanitized Form Fields): Sensitive identifiers (Names, Phone Numbers, Emails, Payment Cards, SSN/National IDs, IBANs, Medical Record Numbers, Tax IDs) are replaced in-memory with deterministic tokens such as [NAME_1], [PHONE_1], [EMAIL_1], and [SSN_1]. Downstream CRMs, email notifications, and AI triage agents process the inquiry with zero exposure to raw PII/PHI.
  2. Private Vault Envelope (_ztds_vault_payload): The original cleartext mapping is encrypted inside the visitor’s browser using native WebCrypto (AES-256-GCM + PBKDF2-SHA256) and attached as a sealed hidden payload. Authorized administrators can decrypt and reveal original entries in 1 click inside the WordPress Admin dashboard using their local browser key.

Supported Form Builders

  • Contact Form 7 (form.wpcf7-form)
  • WPForms (form.wpforms-form)
  • Elementor Forms (form.elementor-form)
  • Gravity Forms (.gform_wrapper form, form[id^="gform_"])
  • Fluent Forms (form.fluentform)
  • Custom HTML / AJAX Forms (via data-ztds="true" or custom CSS selectors in Settings)

Key Architectural Guarantees

  • Zero External Network Egress: 100% of detection, tokenization, and encryption executes locally in the visitor’s browser (window.crypto.subtle). Zero bytes of form content are ever transmitted to PrivacyScrubber or third-party servers.
  • Fail-Open Business Continuity: If a legacy browser lacks WebCrypto support or encounters a custom DOM exception, the interceptor gracefully bypasses tokenization so your business never loses an inbound lead.
  • Statutory Risk Minimization: Technical & Organizational Measure (TOM) supporting GDPR Article 32 pseudonymization, HIPAA Safe Harbor (45 CFR § 164.514(b)), and PCI-DSS v4.0 intake hygiene.

External Services & Privacy Disclosure

This plugin executes 100% locally in the visitor’s browser and does not transmit any form data, visitor PII, or telemetry to any external server. Optional verification badge links to https://privacyscrubber.com/integrations/wordpress/ and https://ztds.ai/ are strictly controlled by the site administrator under Settings -> PrivacyScrubber ZTDS.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the privacyscrubber-wp-guard folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin ZIP through the WordPress Plugins -> Add New -> Upload Plugin screen.
  2. Activate PrivacyScrubber ZTDS Guard through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings -> PrivacyScrubber ZTDS to select your ZTDS RFC v1.0 baseline profile (General or Medical), configure custom form selectors, or toggle the verification badge.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin send form submissions to an external API or cloud server?

No. All PII detection, token replacement ([NAME_1], [EMAIL_1]), and AES-256-GCM vault encryption run locally inside the visitor’s web browser (assets/ztds-form-guard.js). No external API requests are made during form submission.

How do administrators read the original unmasked values?

When viewing entries in your WordPress Admin panel, assets/ztds-admin.js detects the _ztds_vault_payload field and renders a 1-Click Local Reveal control. Decryption occurs locally in the administrator’s browser memory.

Are all features in this WordPress plugin unlocked under GPLv2+?

Yes. This plugin provides the complete ZTDS RFC v1.0 Reference Form Guard (General universal PII/secrets baseline and Medical intake profile) plus Dual-Envelope AES-256-GCM browser vaulting 100% free and unrestricted under GPLv2 or later.
sections.changelog:
2.4.8

  • Synchronized ZTDS RFC v1.0 reference baseline engine with v2.4.8.
  • Added dual-authority ZTDS verification seal with independent administrator toggles for badge visibility and verification links (opt-in by default per WordPress.org Guideline 10).
  • Added native Gravity Forms (form[id^="gform_"]) selector support.
  • Streamlined profile selector to the two native standalone ZTDS RFC v1.0 reference profiles (General and Medical) with zero local quota restrictions under GPLv2+.

2.4.2

  • Initial public release of Plane 6 WordPress ZTDS Form Guard with Dual-Envelope WebCrypto (AES-256-GCM) vaulting.
